key.name: enabled
key.description: Windows on a monitor are arranged by the chosen layout, none over another. Off: windows are left where they are. Dialogs and full-screen windows are never tiled. A window that is maximized when the tiling starts is brought into a tile; one you maximize afterwards stays maximized until you restore it.

key.name: layout
key.description: How the windows are arranged: Dwindle (splits again and again), Master left/right, Center master, Grid, Three columns, Horizontal or Vertical split, Scrolling, Monocle.

key.name: gap-inner
key.description: Space between tiled windows, in pixels (0-40).

key.name: gap-outer
key.description: Space between the tiles and the edge of the work area, in pixels (0-60).

key.name: master-factor
key.description: The share of the screen the main window takes in the Master layouts (0.1-0.9).

key.name: column-width
key.summary: Width of a column in Scrolling
key.description: The share of the screen one column takes in the Scrolling layout (0.2-1).

key.name: layout-map
key.description: JSON: {"workspaces": {"2": "grid"}, "monitors": {"1": "master-left"}}. A workspace's own layout wins over its monitor's, which wins over Layout. Set it from the panel or `niro-tile apply`.

key.name: window-rules
key.description: JSON list: {"match": "org.gnome.Calculator", "action": "float"} keeps an app out of the tiling, "tile" tiles it anyway, {"match": "firefox", "workspace": 2} sends its windows to workspace 2 when they open.

key.name: monitor-recovery
key.summary: Move windows back and forth when a monitor leaves and returns
key.description: When a monitor is unplugged its windows go to the primary monitor, and go back to it when it returns. Off by default. Only windows are moved; no display setting is changed.

key.name: rules-engine
key.description: Reads the rules in "advanced-rules" (conditions, priority, stop) on top of the simple ones. Off by default; windows already open are not touched.

key.name: advanced-rules
key.description: JSON list: {"id": "calc", "conditions": {"appId": "org.gnome.Calculator"}, "actions": {"tile": "float", "above": true}, "priority": 1, "stop": false}. Conditions: appId, title, workspace, monitor, type, time, profile. Actions: workspace, monitor, tile, above.

key.name: animate
key.description: A window that goes to its tile glides there instead of jumping. Follows the system's animations switch.

key.name: floating-apps
key.description: Window classes (the app id, like org.gnome.Calculator) that stay as they are: calculators, pickers and the like.

key.name: shortcut-toggle
key.description: Turns the tiling of windows on and off.

key.name: shortcut-layout
key.description: Goes to the next layout in the list.

key.name: shortcut-promote
key.summary: Make the window the main one
key.description: Moves the focused window to the first place: the main window of the Master layouts.

key.name: shortcut-float
key.description: Takes the focused window out of the tiling, or puts it back.

key.name: shortcut-grow
key.description: Makes the main window of the Master layouts bigger.

key.name: shortcut-shrink
key.description: Makes the main window of the Master layouts smaller.

key.name: shortcut-switcher
key.description: Opens the list of layouts: type to search, arrows and Enter, or click, to apply one to this workspace.

key.name: shortcut-focus-left
key.summary: Focus the window on the left
key.description: Moves the focus to the tiled window nearest on the left.

key.name: shortcut-focus-right
key.summary: Focus the window on the right
key.description: Moves the focus to the tiled window nearest on the right.

key.name: shortcut-focus-up
key.description: Moves the focus to the tiled window nearest above.

key.name: shortcut-focus-down
key.description: Moves the focus to the tiled window nearest below.

key.name: shortcut-swap-left
key.summary: Swap with the window on the left
key.description: Trades places with the tiled window nearest on the left.

key.name: shortcut-swap-right
key.summary: Swap with the window on the right
key.description: Trades places with the tiled window nearest on the right.

key.name: shortcut-swap-up
key.description: Trades places with the tiled window nearest above.

key.name: shortcut-swap-down
key.description: Trades places with the tiled window nearest below.
